verdicts.flaw_description: A named alternative cause reaches every plot: "Prey abundance on the surrounding farmland ran a third above the previous year's, and every box stood at the farmland edge, within the birds' foraging range." A one-third rise in food supply inside the flycatchers' foraging range is enough on its own to raise fledging success at all four plots relative to the previous spring, so the extra 9-16 young cannot be attributed to the boxes.

The measured population is narrower than the cohort the claim is about: "Pass rates cover the students who attended every block, and about a quarter of each cohort missed at least one block." Roughly 25% of each cohort - precisely the least-engaged students - is dropped from the numbers, so the 4-8 point gain is a per-protocol figure for self-selected full attenders, not the tutored cohorts' pass rate.
